# Noryvex AI Receptionist

Our AI Receptionist is a 24/7 virtual assistant built for small businesses. It answers every incoming call, even when your team are busy with serving customers, so you never miss a customer inquiry or booking. It answers common questions about your services, hours, location, and other FAQs using your business's own information. It can also take appointment or inquiry inquiries, collect customer details, and qualify callers before passing them to your team. Every conversation can be automatically saved to Google Sheets or your CRM. If a caller needs to speak with someone directly, the AI transfers the call to your staff. Available 24/7, it reduces missed calls and saves your front desk time — without replacing your team.

## Niche-Specific Solutions

### Dental & Medical Clinics
Our AI Receptionist is a 24/7 virtual assistant built for dental and medical clinics. It answers every incoming call, even when your front desk staff are busy with serving patients, so you never miss a patient inquiry or booking. It answers common questions about your dental services, accepted insurances, hours, location, and other FAQs using your business's own information. It can also take appointment or consultation inquiries, collect patient details, and qualify callers before passing them to your team. Every conversation can be automatically saved to Google Sheets or your CRM. If a caller needs to speak with someone directly, the AI transfers the call to your staff. Available 24/7, it reduces missed calls and saves your front desk time — without replacing your team.

### Cafes & Restaurants
Our AI Receptionist is a 24/7 virtual assistant built for cafes and restaurants. It answers every incoming call, even when your staff are busy with serving customers, so you never miss a order or reservation or booking. It answers common questions about your menu, hours, catering, hours, location, and other FAQs using your business's own information. It can also take reservation or order inquiries, collect customer details, and qualify callers before passing them to your team. Every conversation can be automatically saved to Google Sheets or your CRM. If a caller needs to speak with someone directly, the AI transfers the call to your staff. Available 24/7, it reduces missed calls and saves your front desk time — without replacing your team.

### Home Service Businesses
Our AI Receptionist is a 24/7 virtual assistant built for home service businesses. It answers every incoming call, even when your team are busy with on-site jobs, so you never miss a service request or booking. It answers common questions about your services, pricing, availability, hours, location, and other FAQs using your business's own information. It can also take service or quote inquiries, collect customer details, and qualify callers before passing them to your team. Every conversation can be automatically saved to Google Sheets or your CRM. If a caller needs to speak with someone directly, the AI transfers the call to your staff. Available 24/7, it reduces missed calls and saves your front desk time — without replacing your team.

### Salons & Spas
Our AI Receptionist is a 24/7 virtual assistant built for salons and spas. It answers every incoming call, even when your front desk staff are busy with serving clients, so you never miss a booking inquiry or booking. It answers common questions about your services, pricing, hours, location, and other FAQs using your business's own information. It can also take appointment inquiries, collect client details, and qualify callers before passing them to your team. Every conversation can be automatically saved to Google Sheets or your CRM. If a caller needs to speak with someone directly, the AI transfers the call to your staff. Available 24/7, it reduces missed calls and saves your front desk time — without replacing your team.
